data_objects.name: mobile_tenant_scores
data_objects.meaning: Timestamped score events associated with an anonymized mobile identifier and tenant.

variables.name: gmt_occur
variables.meaning: Event timestamp formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; the timezone is not stated.

variables.name: mobile_md5
variables.meaning: Anonymized mobile identifier represented by PHONE_ followed by a zero-padded number, despite the md5-oriented column name.

variables.name: tenant
variables.meaning: Categorical tenant identifier encoded as TENANT_ followed by a zero-padded number.

variables.name: score
variables.meaning: Numeric score on an undocumented scale; -1 appears to be a possible special value.

structure.description: Each row is a timestamped mobile-tenant score event; mobile_md5 can recur and is the entity-linking field.

uncertainties: The timezone, score calibration, and interpretation of -1 are not documented.
The file does not state whether repeated mobile identifiers represent repeated requests or distinct applications.
annotation_notes: mobile_md5 should be handled as an opaque categorical identifier, not parsed as a number.
